githubTools:
PREPARE GITHUB
Git saves your profile. GitHub CLI lets this assistant configure your fork and automatic updates.
githubInstallingTool: Installing {0}... Windows may ask for your permission.
githubToolInstallFailed: Automatic installation did not finish. Install this tool from its official page, then continue here.
githubLogin:
CONNECT YOUR GITHUB ACCOUNT
Press Enter to start. GitHub will display a code and open your browser. Sign in as the owner of your fork and authorize GitHub CLI.
This connection will let the assistant save your profile and configure automatic publication. It will not ask for your GitHub password here.
githubRetry:
1. I have fixed the problem: check again.
0. Stop and resume later.
profileChoose:
CHOOSE YOUR PROFILE

0. Stop.

profileId: Profile folder name (lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens; up to 30 characters)
profileName: Your studio name, as it will appear on your website
profileLanguage: Main website language: fr or en
profileSelected: Selected profile: {0}. You can customize its copy, photos and style.
profileInvalid: Choose a short name other than studio, cadrora or atelier-giulia, and language fr or en.
profileExists: Another profile already uses this name. No files were overwritten. Resume its original installation, or choose another installation name.
profileMissing: The selected profile folder is missing. Restore it from your fork before continuing.
githubConfirm:
Save to GitHub and publish the website?
Press Enter to start, or type STOP to resume later.
githubConfiguring:
CONFIGURE AUTOMATIC UPDATES
Saving variables and private keys in this website's GitHub environment...
githubWatching:
GITHUB IS PUBLISHING YOUR WEBSITE
The first check can take several minutes. Follow it using the link below. Ctrl+C stops the assistant; GitHub will continue and resume will find this publication.
githubRunWaiting: Checks or publication are running on GitHub...
githubRunRecovery:
FOLLOW THE PUBLICATION
Publication is not confirmed yet. Open the details to see whether GitHub is waiting for approval or reporting an error.
1. Check again.
2. Open the publication in GitHub.
3. Explicitly retry a failed or unstarted publication.
0. Stop and resume later.
githubCommandFailed: The GitHub operation did not finish. Check your connection and GitHub CLI access to your fork, then resume with the same name. Saved steps will be checked before continuing.
githubForkRequired: The assistant needs your GitHub fork, not the upstream repository. Create your fork, clone it to this computer, then run its setup.ps1.
githubCheckoutRequired: This folder must be a Git checkout of your fork with a selected branch. Clone your fork, then run setup.ps1 there. A ZIP download is not enough for automatic updates.
githubPermissions: GitHub did not authorize this operation. Sign GitHub CLI in as the fork owner with gh auth login. To add scopes to an existing token: gh auth refresh -h github.com -s repo,workflow. Environments require repository administration rights and a compatible GitHub plan.
githubGitFailed: Git did not finish the operation. Check access to your fork, the branch and any conflicts, then resume. No force push will be performed.
githubTargetChanged: This installation is already bound to another repository, profile, domain or environment. Resume with its original configuration, or use a new installation name.
githubConfigInvalid: The deployment configuration is invalid. Check this installation's file in .cadrora/deployments before continuing.
githubConfigConflict: Two installations use the same environment or domain. Correct their configuration in .cadrora/deployments; each website needs its own target.
githubSecretsMissing: Required deployment keys are missing. Resume the Cloudflare steps with the same installation name.
githubEnvironmentInUse: This GitHub environment already contains secrets without this installation's identity. They will not be replaced. Use a new installation name.
githubCredentialsMissing: GitHub already has administrator secrets, but their local file is missing. Restore admin-credentials.env from your backup. The password will not be regenerated.
githubSecretsChanged: GitHub secrets changed since the last configuration. Check the environment and restore the expected values before resuming; the assistant will not silently replace them.
githubBranchPolicy: This environment requires a protected branch. Protect the selected branch in GitHub, or adjust that rule yourself before resuming.
githubSettingsUnverified: GitHub variables or secrets could not be confirmed. Publication has not started. Check the environment and resume.
githubUnsafeFiles: The profile contains a hidden file or private key. Remove it from the profile folder before continuing; it will not be sent to GitHub.
githubUnrelatedChanges: This checkout contains changes outside the profile and this installation's files. Commit and push them separately, or set them aside, then resume. The assistant will not include them in its commit.
githubRemoteChanged: The local branch and GitHub changed since preparation. Synchronize them without losing your changes, then check the saved progress before resuming. No force push was performed.
githubFilesChanged: The installation commit is already prepared, but its files changed afterward. Keep your changes safe and restore that commit to finish publishing it; you can push your changes afterward.
githubCommitMissing: No installation commit is saved. Resume the Save and publish step.
githubRunInvalid: The publication found does not match the expected commit, branch or environment. Check GitHub Actions before continuing.
githubDeploymentChanged: The version published on Cloudflare has changed since this installation. Review the latest publication in GitHub Actions before resuming. No new deployment will be started automatically.
githubKeysChanged:
UPDATE PUBLICATION KEYS
The current keys are not yet associated with a confirmed publication. I will synchronize them with GitHub and republish the saved commit. Your administrator password stays the same. If a publication is still running, I will wait for it to finish.
githubKeysConfirm: Update the keys and republish? Press Enter to continue, or type STOP to resume later.
githubRerunUnconfirmed: GitHub has not confirmed that the rerun started. Check again, open GitHub, or explicitly choose Retry. No new attempt starts automatically.
githubAuthentication: GitHub no longer accepts your login. Sign in again using gh auth login, then resume with the same installation name.
githubNetwork: The connection was interrupted or timed out. Check Internet access and resume. Any publication already accepted will be looked up before a new attempt.
githubRateLimited: GitHub is temporarily limiting requests. Wait a few minutes, then resume with the same installation name.
githubProviderUnavailable: GitHub is experiencing a temporary problem. Wait and resume; do not recreate your keys for this error.
githubGitConflict: The branch has a conflict or GitHub has advanced. Synchronize your checkout without losing your changes, then resume. No force push was performed.
githubRequestInvalid: GitHub rejected the parameters for this operation. Check the indicated log and your repository rules before resuming.
githubToolMissing: A required tool could not be found. Restart the assistant to check Git, GitHub CLI and Node.js.
